vagas.title: Technical solution engineer - sao paulo
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Technical solution engineer - sao paulo em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About CATL CATL invites you to continue our legend of green energy! CATL is a World Fortune 300 Company, a global leader who provides premier EV battery and energy storage battery for the world. CATL's EV battery consumption volume has ranked No.1 in the world for seven consecutive years and global energy storage battery shipment has also ranked No.1 for three consecutive years. Job Description ESS Technical Solution Engineer is the combination of application engineer and sales engineer. A technical solution engineer should support and service the customer by demonstrating the product function, technical benefits and value to help customer meet their company and business goals and help company to win projects. Combining technical knowledge with strong communication and interpersonal skills, work closely with clients, understanding their specific needs, and then leverage their in-depth understanding of the company's products or services to provide tailored solutions that meet those needs effectively. Additionally, technical solution engineers should gather feedback from clients and bridge the gap between internal development team and customer requirements, helping to refine products and services based on customer needs and experiences. Responsibilities: Product Demonstration: Deep understanding of the products or services of products and company. Be able to explain complex technical concepts to clients in a clear and understandable manner and contribute to sales presentations, as well as demonstrating products benefits, value and completed applications Client Engagement: Interact directly with clients to understand their needs, challenges, and requirements as well as the competition information from the competitors. Engage in discussions to gather information, analyze the client's projects and requirements, and identify opportunities where company's solutions can add value to win the opportunities Solution Development: Once understand the client's needs, sales engineers work to develop solutions that align with the client's projects. This may involve collaborating with the technical team to design tailored solutions that address specific challenges. Provide clients with technical support as needed and relay information to our development teams for product development and update needs Proposal Creation: Create detailed proposals that outline the proposed solution and its benefits. These proposals need to address the technical aspects while also highlighting the business value for the client as well as prepare the documents according to customer requirements which may include specifications, user's manual, disposal proposal, etc., Technical Support: Provide ongoing technical support to clients, answering questions, addressing concerns, and helping with any technical issues that arise Technical Agreement Negotiations: Involve in negotiations with clients, addressing any technical concerns, clarifying expectations, and ensuring that both parties are aligned on the proposed solution to form final technical agreement Risk Assessment and Problem Solving: Identify the possible issues ahead and provide preventative solutions for the risks. Resolve the technical issues during manufacturing, delivering and commissioning until successfully hand over to customer. Cooperate with internal development and project management team if needed Market Research: Stay informed about market trends, competitor offerings, and customer feedback. Generate ideas for product and service improvement and innovation based on market trends and customer inputs  Requirements and skills: Based in (or open to relocation) Sao Paulo At least 2 years work experience in local ESS market Previous work experience as an AE or SE of ESS market is advantageous Previous experience in utility or ESS developer company is advantageous Knowledge of local ESS projects development requirements is advantageous Exceptional customer service and interpersonal skills Excellent market and competitor analysis abilities Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities Superb collaboration and communication Superb logical and strategic thinking abilities Proficient in English & Portuguese

vagas.title: Programa trainee vértua: formação de assessores
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Programa trainee vértua: formação de assessores em cascavel. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

A Vértua Investimentos está selecionando novos talentos para integrar sua operação em Cascavel. Nosso Programa Trainee foi desenvolvido para quem deseja construir uma carreira sólida e de alta performance no mercado financeiro, com um caminho claro e meritocrático para se tornar sócio do escritório. Não exigimos experiência prévia ou certificações iniciais. Nosso foco é investir no seu potencial e fornecer as ferramentas necessárias para sua ascensão profissional. A Trilha de Desenvolvimento do Trainee: Ingresso e Formação Técnica (ANCORD): Você entra no time com contratação imediata. A Vértua fornece o curso preparatório e todo o suporte necessário para que você obtenha a certificação ANCORD o mais rápido possível, habilitando sua atuação oficial no mercado. Imersão Comercial (SDR): Com a certificação em mãos, você inicia sua atuação como SDR (Sales Development Representative). Esta fase é focada no desenvolvimento de habilidades de prospecção e relacionamento, aprendendo a dominar a abordagem estratégica e a psicologia do investidor. Aceleração por Meritocracia: O programa é pautado por resultados. Ao atingir as metas estabelecidas na fase de SDR, você dobra seu salário base, marcando sua prontidão para os próximos níveis de responsabilidade. Ascensão a Assessor de Investimentos: Após o sucesso comercial inicial, você assume sua própria carteira de clientes, atuando na gestão patrimonial e no atendimento direto a investidores. Liderança e Partnership (Sociedade): Profissionais que demonstram excelência na entrega e capacidade de gestão ascendem à liderança de times. Na Vértua, o resultado entregue desde o primeiro dia como assessor é o critério para o ingresso no plano de sociedade, permitindo que você se torne sócio do negócio. Requisitos do Programa: Paixão pelo Mercado Financeiro: Este é o nosso único requisito essencial. Você não precisa saber o que é um "CDB" hoje, mas deve ter um interesse real em aprender e dominar o assunto. Gosto em Aprender: O dia a dia da profissão exige conversar com pessoas constantemente. É fundamental estar aberto e disposto para construir relacionamentos profissionais, entender as dificuldades e absorver experiências. Perfil Ambicioso: Buscamos pessoas que não se acomodam com o fixo e desejam o crescimento acelerado que apenas o ganho variável e a sociedade podem proporcionar. Localidade: Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em Cascavel/PR. O que a Vértua oferece: Contratação imediata com plano de carreira estruturado; Curso preparatório para ANCORD totalmente custeado pela empresa; Cultura de Meritocracia Radical (dobra salarial por performance); Oportunidade realde Equity (Sociedade) baseada em resultados. Como se candidatar: Se você deseja transformar seu interesse pelo mercado financeiro em uma carreira de sócio em um dos escritórios que mais cresce na região, candidate-se agora!

vagas.title: Senior sales manager -new energy & ev charging
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior sales manager -new energy & ev charging em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Job Summary We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Overseas Sales Manager to spearhead the market expansion and sales of our comprehensive portfolio, including energy metering products (electricity, water, gas meters) and new energy storage solutions (commercial & industrial energy storage, smart micro-grids, EV charging piles). This role is pivotal in driving revenue growth, establishing long-term customer relationships, and strengthening our market position internationally. Your Role and Responsibilities Business Development & Revenue Generation: Take full ownership of achieving and exceeding assigned annual sales targets for the designated territory.  Aggressively identify, generate, and pursue new sales leads and business opportunities within the energy sector.  Customer & Channel Management: Develop and maintain long-term, strategic relationships with a diverse client base, including utility companies, EPC contractors, distributors, and end-users.  Manage key accounts to ensure high levels of customer satisfaction, account growth, and contract renewal.  Strategic Sales Execution: Conduct in-depth customer needs analysis and develop tailored solutions and compelling proposals to win business.  Manage the entire sales cycle from lead qualification and proposal development to contract negotiation and project initiation.  Market Intelligence: Participate in international industry tradeshows and conduct market research to gather intelligence on competitor activities, market trends, and regulatory changes.  Provide insightful market analysis reports to inform product development and strategic planning.  Cross-functional Collaboration: Serve as the key liaison between customers and internal teams (technical, project management, logistics, after-sales) to ensure seamless order execution, on-time delivery, and superior customer experience.  Oversee post-sales support coordination to resolve issues promptly and maintain customer satisfaction.  Qualifications Education & Background: Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Automation, International Business, or a related field. An advanced degree is a plus.  Experience: Minimum of 5 years of proven sales experience in international markets, preferably within the energy, metering, or power solution industries.  Strong sales track record of meeting or exceeding quotas and managing complex B2 B sales cycles. Experience with Latin American markets is highly desirable.  Required Skills Sales Expertise: Demonstrated ability in key account management, channel development, and complex project negotiation.  Communication: Excellent interpersonal, presentation, and proposal-writing skills. Fluency in Portuguese is mandatory.  Personal Attributes: Highly self-motivated, results-oriented, and customer-focused. Possess strong business acumen, market sensitivity, and the ability to collaborate effectively in a cross-cultural environment.  Preferred Skills Willingness and ability to accept extended and frequent business trips or assignments.

vagas.title: Country manager, brazil
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Country manager, brazil em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

A Hellotext é a plataforma de marketing conversacional e automação que impulsiona vendas para algumas das marcas de e-commerce mais ambiciosas da América Latina. Com uma base de clientes em rápido crescimento, estamos expandindo nossa presença país por país — e o Brasil é a próxima grande prioridade. Esta não é uma posição de suporte ou pré-vendas. Você será a liderança comercial da Hellotext no Brasil, com foco absoluto em vendas enterprise, abertura de mercado e geração de receita. Sua missão Construir e escalar a operação comercial da Hellotext no Brasil, fechando as primeiras contas estratégicas, abrindo relacionamento com líderes C-Level e estabelecendo a empresa como referência em marketing conversacional para e-commerce e varejo enterprise. Você será responsável por gerar, qualificar e fechar negócios, além de criar as bases para o crescimento futuro do país. O que você fará Liderar o go-to-market comercial da Hellotext no Brasil, com foco em vendas B2 B enterprise. Prospectar, desenvolver e fechar negócios com marcas médias e enterprise de e-commerce e varejo. Abrir e manter relacionamento direto com CMOs, Heads de E-commerce, Diretores Digitais e VPs. Executar outbound estratégico multicanal (Linked In, telefone, Whats App, eventos, visitas presenciais). Conduzir reuniões executivas, apresentações comerciais e negociações complexas. Representando a área de psicologia em fóruns institucionais, comitês e interações com áreas parceiras e clientes. Coordenando programas e iniciativas de saúde mental, assegurando execução e resultados mensuráveis. Supervisionando tecnicamente a atuação dos profissionais, garantindo qualidade dos registros e condutas. Promovendo educação permanente e atualização técnica da equipe, alinhada às boas práticas e legislações. Principais responsabilidades: Será a pessoal responsável técnica institucional perante o CRP, com abrangência nacional. Conduzir reuniões e alinhamentos com equipe e áreas parceiras. Propor e implementar melhorias em processos assistenciais. Atuar na priorização de demandas operacionais e assistenciais. Representar tecnicamente a área em comitês e fóruns institucionais. Desenvolver programas de saúde mental com impacto mensurável e escalável; Gerenciar múltiplas demandas assistenciais, operacionais e institucionais; Integrar a psicologia de forma estratégica às demais áreas da organização; Implantar e consolidar cultura orientada a indicadores e melhoria contínua; Tomar decisões técnicas relacionadas à prática psicológica, dentro dos limites éticos e regulatórios. Entre outras atividades. O que esperamos de conhecimentos para essa vaga: Formação Superior Completa em Psicologia; Pós ou MBA em Gestão em Saúde, Saúde Mental ou áreas correlatas Ter atuado com gestão de equipes e liderança; Ter habilidade com indicadores de desempenho e qualidade assistencial; Experiencia com protocolos clínicos e fluxos assistenciais e elaboração de relatórios e pareceres técnicos; Ter atuado na estruturação e expansão de programas de saúde emocional em larga escala Experiencia com processos de auditoria e fiscalização, nos modelos de atenção à saúde mental e programas de cuidado; Habilidade e conhecimento de Office. Será um diferencial se você tiver: Atuado com Inteligência Artificial. Ter experiencia em empresas de saúde digital ou telemedicina. A Sul América e empresas do Grupo informam que todas as oportunidades de emprego são divulgadas exclusivamente através dos canais oficiais da empresa. Role summary We are seeking an experienced Public Affairs Specialist to strengthen GS1 Global Public Policy team based in Brazil. Working with the Public Policy team and reporting directly to the Vice President, Global Public Policy, the successful candidate will have 10+ years of prior experience in public policy and government engagement across Latin America (LATAM). This role is a unique opportunity to set the foundation of international public policy across the LATAM region (including Central and South America) with a global perspective. The successful candidate will act as a public policy strategist developing and implementing plans with GS1 Member Organisations in the LATAM Region and with Global Office. They will be GS1's day-to-day point of contact for engagement with GS1 Member Organisations and stakeholders, including governments and regulators, on all public policy matters relevant to GS1 in the region. They will build constructive relationships, provide evidence-based specialist insights, and ensure GS1's positions are understood and reflected in evolving policy frameworks for traceability, trade efficiency, and regulatory compliance across fragmented supply chains.  Education and experience Master's degree with 10+ years of related experience. Stakeholder Networks: Established contacts across national and regional institutions in the LATAM region and experience in building coalitions and coordinating with multi-country stakeholders. A thorough understanding of how international organisations, trade associations, and NGOs function, and work experience in international environments relevant to the region.  Desired experience Sector Knowledge: Understanding of FMCG/retail and consumer goods policy environment (sustainability, product data, packaging, product safety, traceability, e-commerce). Standards & Data: Familiarity with data standards and policy interoperability (preferably GS1 standards, 2 D barcodes, master data, digital product information), and the role of registries in regulatory compliance.  Skills required Strategic Policy Framing: Ability to connect technical standards to policy objectives (consumer protection, sustainability, market surveillance, competition, innovation). Executive Relationships: Credibility with senior officials and industry leaders; ability to develop long-term trusted relationships, adept at informal/formal engagement, drafting amendments and compromise texts. Communication: Excellent written and oral communication in English, Portuguese and Spanish. Analytical Rigour: Strong legislative analysis, impact assessment, and risk/opportunity mapping; able to translate complex dossiers into clear executive guidance. Execution & Collaboration: Comfortable operating in a federated international network; disciplined follow‐through across multiple files; high integrity and respect for competition‐law constraints. Public Representation: Confident public speaker; able to present GS1's neutral, standards‐based positions in diverse regional fora.  Additional Information This job requires up to 25% global travel. vagas.description:

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA Buscamos pessoas que sejam movidas por paixões como a que inspirou o nascimento do Grupo, e que juntamente conosco, estejam dispostas a assumirem os desafios e continuarem escrevendo nossa história! Somos uma empresa de igualdade de oportunidades. Isso significa que, ao tomar decisões sobre a carreira de nossos colaboradores, nossas principais considerações são sua capacidade de realizar seu trabalho e se desenvolver em suas funções. Uma maneira de cultivar a mudança é criando um ambiente de trabalho mais diverso e inclusivo, como cultura organizacional. Para isso, estamos comprometidos em construir um ambiente que seja livre de discriminação e assédio onde todas as pessoas se sintam respeitadas e valorizadas. Nós recrutamos pessoas de mente positiva que compartilham nossos valores fundamentais e nosso compromisso com Sustentabilidade. Venha fazer parte do nosso time! RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES - Garantir a excelência no atendimento do cliente fidelizando o cliente com a marca e trazendo resultados para o atingimento de metas - Acompanhar e orientar o time na jornada de vendas, interagindo e complementando quando visualiza oportunidades. Solucionar possíveis reclamações, trocas. Garantir que 100% da equipe realize os treinamentos online. Ser o multiplicador das estratégias da companhia, liderando pelo exemplo, sendo porta voz de todas as comunicações, garantindo a alta qualidade nos atendimentos - Realizar o controle financeiro, fazendo depósitos semanais e preenchimento de planilhas, assim como controle do caixinha, prezando pelos gastos da loja afim de diminuir despesas. Coordenar a virada da operação a cada campanha dentro dos prazos e seguindo orientações da MMP (material de merchandising promocional), além de manter a loja atrativa para o cliente (organização, precificação, limpeza, estrutura) - Garantir o atingimento das metas e KPIs do time da loja, mantendo a rentabilidade dentro do esperado. - Reportar diretamente ao Supervisor ou Gerente Distrital movimentações da concorrência, oportunidades da praça que a operação esta localizada, buscar parcerias na região. Participar das reuniões, construção de plano de ação, trabalhando estrategicamente no atingimento dos resultados. Buscar desenvolver o time em busca de um sucessor para a sua posição -Realizar a gestão de todo o time, desenvolvendo e engajando os profissionais. Recrutar e selecionar funcionários para a equipe, reportar ao RH dados em relação ao ponto eletrônico e ser o principal vínculo com a área sempre que necessário para que o time esteja completo e munido de informações referente ao RH. REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES - Ensino Médio Completo - Experiência com vendas, gestão de pessoas e indicadores - Necessário disponibilidade e flexibilidade de horário - Desejável experiência no segmento de cosméticos, perfumaria e/ou produtos de beleza - Escala 6 X1 BENEFÍCIOS: Nosso pacote de benefícios é: -Vale Transporte -Vale Refeição/Alimentação (R$ 775,00) -Seguro de Vida -Assistência Médica -Assistência Odontológica -Total Pass -Convênio com o SESC -Voucher de Aniversário -Desconto nos produtos e SPA da marca -Elleve (plataforma de incentivo educacional)

DescriçãoO Engenheiro de Soluções deve apoiar o crescimento de vendas da Good We desenvolvendo fortes relacionamentos com os stakeholders técnicos da rede de distribuidores, instaladores e EPCs da Good We no Brasil, garantindo a confiança deles nas soluções e produtos da Good We. Conduzir treinamentos presenciais e online para os clientes, criar e gerenciar documentação técnica local, estabelecer uma base de conhecimento e representar a Good We em exposições. Fornecer informações ou feedbacks em tempo hábil para propostas de clientes, fornecendo os detalhes técnicos das soluções propostas.ResponsabilidadesRealizar workshops e treinamentos presenciais para parceiros e clientes;Realizar webinars e treinamentos online para parceiros e clientes;Apoiar as equipes de vendas na especificação de projetos;Apoiar as equipes de vendas em visitas a clientes em negociações estratégicas;Realizar simulações de projetos e design para clientes;Realizar tradução de documentos técnicos (fichas técnicas, manuais de usuário, brochuras, apresentações de revistas, etc.);Criar e desenvolver apresentações de portfólio;Criar e desenvolver apresentações de produtos e funcionalidades;Criar documentos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;Criar vídeos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;Gerenciar e participar de exposições e feiras de energia solar (FV);Realizar palestras e apresentações presenciais em fóruns e eventos de energia solar (FV);Fornecer treinamento para a equipe interna brasileira (engenheiros de pós-vendas, equipes de marketing, equipes de vendas, etc.);Configurar e gerenciar a comunidade online da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil;Configurar e gerenciar as redes sociais da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil;Prestar suporte ao cliente em questões de Pré-Vendas;Treinar e certificar a equipe técnica dos parceiros de acordo com a política de canais;Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes da matriz para entender e transmitir as especificações corretas do nosso portfólio para a equipe local, parceiros e clientes;Trabalhar ativamente com a equipe de marketing para estabelecer uma rede de promoção com parceiros de terceiros (empresas de treinamento, influenciadores digitais e distribuidores);Apoiar a equipe de marketing na criação de conteúdo e promoções;Configurar e estabelecer um centro de treinamento no Brasil;Apoiar os gerentes de Produtos e Pré-Vendas na definição do portfólio local;Coletar demandas de produtos do mercado brasileiro;Analisar as demandas de mercado e propor novos produtos e funcionalidades;Coletar e organizar informações sobre produtos, soluções e principais informações de clientes concorrentes;Analisar e fornecer feedback sobre requisitos de normas regulatórias locais.Habilidades RequeridasProficiência em mandarimGraduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Fotovoltaica, Energias Renováveis ou formação similar;Conhecimento avançado de inversores fotovoltaicos;Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência com inversores fotovoltaicos;Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;Experiência com GD, experiência com projetos de GC é um diferencial;Experiência com inversores de armazenamento de energia fotovoltaica;Experiência com baterias de chumbo-ácido e lítio para sistemas de armazenamento fotovoltaico;Conhecimento geral de eletricidade, produtos, soluções de produtos e processos;Excelentes conhecimentos em Auto CAD e PVSyst;Fortes habilidades analíticas, atenção aos detalhes e habilidades de comunicação;Domínio do MS Office e outros softwares de energia solar (PV);Conhecimento avançado em MS Power Point;Ampla rede de contatos no setor de energia renovável, principalmente na indústria solar fotovoltaica;Fortes habilidades de ensino e comunicação.AtributosProatividade;Excelentes habilidades organizacionais com capacidade de rapidamente avaliar prioridades;Mentalidade internacional para um ambiente multicultural;Fortes relações no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;Trabalho em equipe;Independência (trabalhar sem supervisão direta);Senso de urgência;Multitarefa;Disponibilidade para viagens de negócios;Disponibilidade para se mudar de cidade.

vagas.title: Strategic partnership & alliance
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Strategic partnership & alliance em suzano. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Rate GainRate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the roleRate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibilityBuild and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAMIdentify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystemCollaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreementsRepresent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutionsMonitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenueProvide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trendsEducation & Work ExperienceBachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnershipsKnowledge:In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystemKnowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structuresAwareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectorsSkills:Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilitiesExcellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levelsAdvanced verbal and written communication skills inSpanish, Portuguese, and EnglishAbility to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunitiesProficiency in using CRM and sales enablement toolsSkilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)Attitude:Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targetsEntrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovationCulturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote teamHigh level of integrity, professionalism, and ownershipResilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

Dê o próximo passo para alcançar o sucesso em sua carreira e vem para a legião de roxinhos!

About Rate GainRate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the roleRate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. vagas.title: Engenheiro de soluções - especialista bess
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Engenheiro de soluções - especialista bess em guarulhos. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

DescriçãoO Engenheiro de Soluções deve apoiar o crescimento de vendas da Good We desenvolvendo fortes relacionamentos com os stakeholders técnicos da rede de distribuidores, instaladores e EPCs da Good We no Brasil, garantindo a confiança deles nas soluções e produtos da Good We. Conduzir treinamentos presenciais e online para os clientes, criar e gerenciar documentação técnica local, estabelecer uma base de conhecimento e representar a Good We em exposições. Fornecer informações ou feedbacks em tempo hábil para propostas de clientes, fornecendo os detalhes técnicos das soluções propostas.ResponsabilidadesRealizar workshops e treinamentos presenciais para parceiros e clientes;Realizar webinars e treinamentos online para parceiros e clientes;Apoiar as equipes de vendas na especificação de projetos;Apoiar as equipes de vendas em visitas a clientes em negociações estratégicas;Realizar simulações de projetos e design para clientes;Realizar tradução de documentos técnicos (fichas técnicas, manuais de usuário, brochuras, apresentações de revistas, etc.);Criar e desenvolver apresentações de portfólio;Criar e desenvolver apresentações de produtos e funcionalidades;Criar documentos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;Criar vídeos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;Gerenciar e participar de exposições e feiras de energia solar (FV);Realizar palestras e apresentações presenciais em fóruns e eventos de energia solar (FV);Fornecer treinamento para a equipe interna brasileira (engenheiros de pós-vendas, equipes de marketing, equipes de vendas, etc.);Configurar e gerenciar a comunidade online da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil;Configurar e gerenciar as redes sociais da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil;Prestar suporte ao cliente em questões de Pré-Vendas;Treinar e certificar a equipe técnica dos parceiros de acordo com a política de canais;Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes da matriz para entender e transmitir as especificações corretas do nosso portfólio para a equipe local, parceiros e clientes;Trabalhar ativamente com a equipe de marketing para estabelecer uma rede de promoção com parceiros de terceiros (empresas de treinamento, influenciadores digitais e distribuidores);Apoiar a equipe de marketing na criação de conteúdo e promoções;Configurar e estabelecer um centro de treinamento no Brasil;Apoiar os gerentes de Produtos e Pré-Vendas na definição do portfólio local;Coletar demandas de produtos do mercado brasileiro;Analisar as demandas de mercado e propor novos produtos e funcionalidades;Coletar e organizar informações sobre produtos, soluções e principais informações de clientes concorrentes;Analisar e fornecer feedback sobre requisitos de normas regulatórias locais.Habilidades RequeridasProficiência em mandarimGraduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Fotovoltaica, Energias Renováveis ou formação similar;Conhecimento avançado de inversores fotovoltaicos;Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência com inversores fotovoltaicos;Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;Experiência com GD, experiência com projetos de GC é um diferencial;Experiência com inversores de armazenamento de energia fotovoltaica;Experiência com baterias de chumbo-ácido e lítio para sistemas de armazenamento fotovoltaico;Conhecimento geral de eletricidade, produtos, soluções de produtos e processos;Excelentes conhecimentos em Auto CAD e PVSyst;Fortes habilidades analíticas, atenção aos detalhes e habilidades de comunicação;Domínio do MS Office e outros softwares de energia solar (PV);Conhecimento avançado em MS Power Point;Ampla rede de contatos no setor de energia renovável, principalmente na indústria solar fotovoltaica;Fortes habilidades de ensino e comunicação.AtributosProatividade;Excelentes habilidades organizacionais com capacidade de rapidamente avaliar prioridades;Mentalidade internacional para um ambiente multicultural;Fortes relações no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;Trabalho em equipe;Independência (trabalhar sem supervisão direta);Senso de urgência;Multitarefa;Disponibilidade para viagens de negócios;Disponibilidade para se mudar de cidade.

Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the roleRate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Legal writer em porto alegre. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

U. S. Immigration Law Firm, Law offices of Jacob J Sapochnick is growing and developing law firm in the USA that specializes in business, employment, investment, and family immigration to the USA. The law firm is known for providing its best to the clients by offering creative and strategic legal solutions. We are looking for the new team member, legal writer, to join our team.Responsibilities:Legal Brief & Petition Drafting:Preparinglegal briefs , includingpersonal statements, expert opinions, and supporting arguments.Engaging inextensive drafting , developingpersuasive and well-structured argumentstailored to each case.Case Strategy & Implementation:Collaborating withsenior legal specialists and U. S. attorneysto understand and execute case strategy effectively.Ensuring that all legal arguments align with case objectives and meet the highest professional standards.Legal Research & Analysis:Conductingin-depth legal researchto identifyrelevant statutes, judicial decisions, and immigration regulationsStaying up to date withevolving immigration laws and policy changesto ensure compliance and accuracy.Be creative in drafting – must have!!!Document ReviewReviewingclient-provided documentation , identifying missing materialsEnsuring petitions arefully prepared in advancefor mid and final attorney reviews, facilitating timely submission.Attorney Support & Quality Assurance:Assisting attorneys in case preparation, includinggathering supporting documents, drafting legal arguments, and compiling evidence.Collaborating withteam members to enhance the accuracy, clarity, and persuasiveness of all written materials.Requirements:·Excellent grammar, spelling, and written English composition skills is a must.·B. A. Degree in Law or Political Sciences or English studies student or graduate.·Previous legal or immigration writing experience preferred.·Extraordinary research and creative writing skills in English.·High level of accuracy, attention to detail, and excellent proofreading skills.·Strong organizational skills; ability to work under pressure, work within competing deadlines, and prioritize workload effectively.·Strong technical aptitude, including the ability to quickly learn new applications.Salary depending on experience from $ - $ .

About Rate GainRate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the roleRate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. structuresAwareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectorsSkills:Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilitiesExcellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levelsAdvanced verbal and written communication skills inSpanish, Portuguese, and EnglishAbility to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunitiesProficiency in using CRM and sales enablement toolsSkilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)Attitude:Proactive and DescriçãoO Engenheiro de Soluções deve apoiar o crescimento de vendas da Good We desenvolvendo fortes relacionamentos com os stakeholders técnicos da rede de distribuidores, instaladores e EPCs da Good We no Brasil, garantindo a confiança deles nas soluções e produtos da Good We. Conduzir treinamentos presenciais e online para os clientes, criar e gerenciar documentação técnica local, estabelecer uma base de conhecimento e representar a Good We em exposições. Fornecer informações ou feedbacks em tempo hábil para propostas de clientes, fornecendo os detalhes técnicos das soluções propostas.ResponsabilidadesRealizar workshops e treinamentos presenciais para parceiros e clientes;Realizar webinars e treinamentos online para parceiros e clientes;Apoiar as equipes de vendas na especificação de projetos;Apoiar as equipes de vendas em visitas a clientes em negociações estratégicas;Realizar simulações de projetos e design para clientes;Realizar tradução de documentos técnicos (fichas técnicas, manuais de usuário, brochuras, apresentações de revistas, etc.);Criar e desenvolver apresentações de portfólio;Criar e desenvolver apresentações de produtos e funcionalidades;Criar documentos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;Criar vídeos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;Gerenciar e participar de exposições e feiras de energia solar (FV);Realizar palestras e apresentações presenciais em fóruns e eventos de energia solar (FV);Fornecer Brasil;Configurar e gerenciar as redes sociais da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil;Prestar suporte ao cliente em questões de Pré-Vendas;Treinar e certificar a equipe técnica dos parceiros de acordo com a política de canais;Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes da matriz para entender e transmitir as especificações corretas do nosso portfólio para a equipe local, parceiros e clientes;Trabalhar ativamente com a equipe de marketing para estabelecer uma rede de promoção com parceiros de terceiros (empresas de treinamento, influenciadores digitais e distribuidores);Apoiar a equipe de marketing na criação de conteúdo e promoções;Configurar e estabelecer um centro de treinamento no Brasil;Apoiar os gerentes de Produtos e Pré-Vendas na definição do portfólio local;Coletar demandas de produtos do mercado brasileiro;Analisar as demandas de mercado e propor novos produtos e funcionalidades;Coletar e organizar informações sobre produtos, soluções e principais informações de clientes concorrentes;Analisar e fornecer feedback sobre requisitos de normas regulatórias locais.Habilidades RequeridasProficiência em mandarimGraduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Fotovoltaica, Energias Renováveis ou formação similar;Conhecimento avançado de inversores fotovoltaicos;Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência com inversores fotovoltaicos;Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;Experiência com GD, experiência com projetos de GC é um diferencial;Experiência com inversores de armazenamento de energia fotovoltaica;Experiência com baterias de chumbo-ácido e lítio para sistemas de armazenamento fotovoltaico;Conhecimento geral de eletricidade, produtos, soluções de produtos e processos;Excelentes conhecimentos em Auto CAD e PVSyst;Fortes habilidades analíticas, atenção aos detalhes e habilidades de comunicação;Domínio do MS Office e outros softwares de energia solar (PV);Conhecimento avançado em MS Power Point;Ampla rede de contatos no setor de energia renovável, principalmente na indústria solar fotovoltaica;Fortes habilidades de ensino e comunicação.AtributosProatividade;Excelentes habilidades organizacionais com capacidade de rapidamente avaliar prioridades;Mentalidade internacional para um ambiente multicultural;Fortes relações no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;Trabalho em equipe;Independência (trabalhar sem supervisão direta);Senso de urgência;Multitarefa;Disponibilidade para viagens de negócios;Disponibilidade para se mudar de cidade.

About Rate GainRate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the roleRate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibilityBuild and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAMIdentify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystemCollaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreementsRepresent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutionsMonitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenueProvide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trendsEducation & Work ExperienceBachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnershipsKnowledge:In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystemKnowledge of Saa S business models and partnership structuresAwareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectorsSkills:Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilitiesExcellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levelsAdvanced verbal and written communication skills inSpanish, Portuguese, and EnglishAbility to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunitiesProficiency in using CRM and sales enablement toolsSkilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)Attitude:Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targetsEntrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovationCulturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote teamHigh level of integrity, professionalism, and ownershipResilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

vagas.title: Strategic partnership & alliance
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Strategic partnership & alliance em viamão. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Rate GainRate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the roleRate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. vagas.description:

DescriçãoO Engenheiro de Soluções deve apoiar o crescimento de vendas da Good We desenvolvendo fortes relacionamentos com os stakeholders técnicos da rede de distribuidores, instaladores e EPCs da Good We no Brasil, garantindo a confiança deles nas soluções e produtos da Good We. Conduzir treinamentos presenciais e online para os clientes, criar e gerenciar documentação técnica local, estabelecer uma base de conhecimento e representar a Good We em exposições. Fornecer informações ou feedbacks em tempo hábil para propostas de clientes, fornecendo os detalhes técnicos das soluções propostas.ResponsabilidadesRealizar workshops e treinamentos presenciais para parceiros e clientes;Realizar webinars e treinamentos online para parceiros e clientes;Apoiar as equipes de vendas na especificação de projetos;Apoiar as equipes de vendas em visitas a clientes em negociações estratégicas;Realizar simulações de projetos e design para clientes;Realizar tradução de documentos técnicos (fichas técnicas, manuais de usuário, brochuras, apresentações de revistas, etc.);Criar e desenvolver apresentações de portfólio;Criar e desenvolver apresentações de produtos e funcionalidades;Criar documentos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;Criar vídeos de SOP sobre produtos e funcionalidades;Gerenciar e participar de exposições e feiras de energia solar (FV);Realizar palestras e apresentações presenciais em fóruns e eventos de energia solar (FV);Fornecer treinamento para a equipe interna brasileira (engenheiros de pós-vendas, equipes de marketing, equipes de vendas, etc.);Configurar e gerenciar a comunidade online da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil;Configurar e gerenciar as redes sociais da Good We Solar Academy no Brasil;Prestar suporte ao cliente em questões de Pré-Vendas;Treinar e certificar a equipe técnica dos parceiros de acordo com a política de canais;Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes da matriz para entender e transmitir as especificações corretas do nosso portfólio para a equipe local, parceiros e clientes;Trabalhar ativamente com a equipe de marketing para estabelecer uma rede de promoção com parceiros de terceiros (empresas de treinamento, influenciadores digitais e distribuidores);Apoiar a equipe de marketing na criação de conteúdo e promoções;Configurar e estabelecer um centro de treinamento no Brasil;Apoiar os gerentes de Produtos e Pré-Vendas na definição do portfólio local;Coletar demandas de produtos do mercado brasileiro;Analisar as demandas de mercado e propor novos produtos e funcionalidades;Coletar e organizar informações sobre produtos, soluções e principais informações de clientes concorrentes;Analisar e fornecer feedback sobre requisitos de normas regulatórias locais.Habilidades RequeridasProficiência em mandarimGraduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Fotovoltaica, Energias Renováveis ou formação similar;Conhecimento avançado de inversores fotovoltaicos;Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência com inversores fotovoltaicos;Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;Experiência com GD, experiência com projetos de GC é um diferencial;Experiência com inversores de armazenamento de energia fotovoltaica;Experiência com baterias de chumbo-ácido e lítio para sistemas de armazenamento fotovoltaico;Conhecimento geral de eletricidade, produtos, soluções de produtos e processos;Excelentes conhecimentos em Auto CAD e PVSyst;Fortes habilidades analíticas, atenção aos detalhes e habilidades de comunicação;Domínio do MS Office e outros softwares de energia solar (PV);Conhecimento avançado em MS Power Point;Ampla rede de contatos no setor de energia renovável, principalmente na indústria solar fotovoltaica;Fortes habilidades de ensino e comunicação.AtributosProatividade;Excelentes habilidades organizacionais com capacidade de rapidamente avaliar prioridades;Mentalidade internacional para um ambiente multicultural;Fortes relações no mercado fotovoltaico brasileiro;Trabalho em equipe;Independência (trabalhar sem supervisão direta);Senso de urgência;Multitarefa;Disponibilidade para viagens de negócios;Disponibilidade para se mudar de cidade.

vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Strategic partnership & alliance em botucatu. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Rate GainRate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the roleRate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibilityBuild and manage strategic management skills with ability to engage partners at all levelsAdvanced verbal and written communication skills inSpanish, Portuguese, and EnglishAbility to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunitiesProficiency in using CRM and sales enablement toolsSkilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)Attitude:Proactive and vagas.title: Implementation analyst
vagas.description:

Job Title:Implementation AnalystEnglish Resume OnlyLocation:BrazilType:Full-Time ContractSetup:Fully RemoteLevel:Mid-LevelIndustry:Software SAAS CompanyShift:US HoursStart Date:can start in 2 weeks after offerEquipment:Available upon requestRate:R$8,000 - R$10,000About The Methodical GroupThe Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.About the OpportunityOur client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.ResponsibilitiesLead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.QualificationsAt least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

About Rate GainRate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the roleRate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibilityBuild and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAMIdentify co-marketing, revenueProvide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trendsEducation & Work ExperienceBachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field5+ years of experience in partnership opportunitiesProficiency in using CRM and sales enablement toolsSkilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)Attitude:Proactive and global, remote teamHigh level of integrity, professionalism, and ownershipResilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

Experience with Go and Kubernetes-based backend systems. Experience with AWS infrastructure. Background in the gaming industry or other high-traffic consumer products. Currently, Voxy's influence reaches worldwide, with committed teams working in various locations such as the United States, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, Thailand, Malaysia, Spain, Italy, and Ireland. Initially concentrated on English language teaching, Voxy has expanded to provide various languages, such as Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, German, and French, serving a wide variety of learners. We think that acquiring a language ought to be enjoyable, fulfilling, and a pathway to the finest experiences life presents. If you're on board, we would be happy to discuss. You can find additional information about our values at this link () The Impact You'll Have at Voxy Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate. What You'll Be Doing: Collections & Cash Application: • Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols. • Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance. • Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams; documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system. • Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters; tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP& A Manager. • Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger; investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments. • Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies. • Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies; prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions. Credit Analysis & Risk Management: • Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history; recommends credit limits and payment terms. • Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk; flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior. • Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies. Reporting & Analysis: • Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review. • Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends. • Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation. • Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP& A Manager or Senior FP& A Analyst. What We're Looking For: • B. A/B. S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration; • 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting; • Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details; • Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company; • Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus; • Based anywhere in Brazil • Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish • Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus. Job Details: • Gross Salary: R$110,500/year • Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3) In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you'll enjoy: • Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity) • Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events • Remote friendly work policies • Professional development budget • Language classes w/ Voxy & Fluentify • Work with an awesome international team of super bright, creative, talented, and passionate individuals based around the world • Time Zones: ET(Eastern Time), BRT(Brasilia Time), SAMT(Samara Standard Time), Central European Time (CET) We believe in a workplace that is meant for everyone. Voxy is an equal opportunity employer. Voxy believes that a creative, engaged and diverse team can transform the market and positively impact people's lives through education. We are sure that the mission of building the most effective way to learn English is done with a plurality of ideas and points of view, which is why we work to promote Diversity, Equity and Inclusion initiatives in our company. In addition to training, benchmarking, and community partnerships, we also work in alignment with our internal DEI Committee. As a reflection of our beliefs around inclusion in the workplace, our selection process has no restrictions; our goal is to assemble a diverse team that will help us be leaders in our market. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. About Rate GainRate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the roleRate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Area sales manager (santa catarina state) em florianópolis. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Ecorobotix SA. creates innovative robotic solutions that reduce the negative ecological impact of modern agriculture. We have developed an AI-based ultra-high precision spot spraying technology that drastically reduces the amount of chemicals used in crop fields while keeping costs competitive. The technology is currently deployed on our tractor towed ARA machine. By joining our talented and dynamic team, you will contribute to a more sustainable, environment-friendly agriculture in an innovative scale-up at the cutting edge of technology. We are a revolutionary organization with a great work environment that supports creativity through self-motivation.To pursue our growth in Brazil, we are hiring an experienced entrepreneurial mind based in Santa Catarina State for an:Area Sales ManagerGeneral objective of the roleAs an Area Sales Manager of the Ecorobotix SA. Team, you will be responsible for managing and expanding the sales of agricultural machinery within a designated region. The role involves overseeing existing dealer relationships, optimizing dealer performance, and driving new business opportunities by identifying future dealers and customers as well as driving revenue growth. The Area Sales Manager will work closely with dealers to ensure product availability, support, and training, ensuring the company’s agricultural machinery is effectively marketed and sold. This position requires a leader with a deep understanding of market dynamics, strong leadership skills, and the ability to foster a results-oriented sales culture within the region.Reporting lines and interactionsThis role reports directly to the Commercial Director. Internally, you will closely collaborate with other members of the Sales team and other teams of Ecorobotix. Externally, you will interact with dealers, farmers, partners, associations, trade shows, Agronomists, and CCA’s.A day in the life of an Area Sales ManagerThe Area Sales Manager will travel across the designated territory to visit key accounts, meet new prospects, and support dealer partners. Whether you're pulling into a grower's yard or a dealership lot, you're the face of a cutting-edge ag-tech company that's reshaping the future of precision spraying.You will showcase how our high-precision sprayer delivers real ROI: less chemical waste, more targeted application, and better yields. You walk growers through the technology— highlighting features like variable rate spraying and intelligent targeting—while grounding every conversation in real-world impact. You sit down and dig into the potential customer’s specific challenges and help them see how the product fits into their operation. You're not just selling equipment; you're helping solve problems.“You’re part field representative, part storyteller, part strategist. You’re a trusted advisor selling value, not just hardware.”Key ResponsibilitiesIdentify and prospect new customers across Brazil, managing all communication and driving the sales process through to contract signature.Engage with customers to understand their needs and provide tailored solutions, ensuring strong order generation and relationship development.Assess customer solvency, share pricing information, negotiate terms, and suggest improvements to optimize pricing strategies.Provide training and ongoing support to partners, while identifying opportunities for expanding and strengthening the partner network.Actively participate in industry fairs, customer demos, and events to increase visibility and drive engagement in the region.Foster collaboration and support within the distributor network to drive sales and enhance product reach.Create compelling content in collaboration with the marketing team to support campaigns and enhance brand presence.QualificationsMaster’s degree in Sales and/or Agronomy, or related field.10+ years of experience in sales and hands-on experience in agriculture, ag-tech, or precision equipment.Willingness to travel domestically in Brazil.Must-HaveExperience in Ag-tech or chemical distribution.Knowledge in Agronomy related to weeding in field crops.Your AssetsExcellent communication and leadership skills, willingness to build relationships with customers.Exceptional written and verbal presentation skills, with clear & consistent communication.High degree of independence, reliability, and spirit of initiative.Driven individual with systematic, goal-oriented working methods.Computer skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Power Point, and CRM tools.Strong organizational and multi-tasking skillsTeam-player

Acompanhar tendências do mercado de tecnologia e estudar continuamente os produtos.
