With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.  Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.  Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.  THE ROLE   We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven  Technical Product Owner  to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4 HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.  What You’ll Do   Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.  Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.  UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.  Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.  Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.  Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.    WHAT IT TAKES   The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).  The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.  The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.  The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.  The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.  The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.    Key Skills    Visionary Leadership:  Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.   Advanced Governance Concepts:  Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.   AI/ML Application:  Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.   Visual Communication:  Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.   Technical Storyboarding:  Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.   Relationship Orchestration:  Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.  Drive for Results:  Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.    Be fully aligned with our core values:  Think Big  - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.  Be Curious  - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.  Take Action  - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.  Stronger Together  - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.  By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.   WHAT WE OFFER   Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.  Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.  Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.  Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.  Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.  An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.    OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION  At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.  We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

Com  mais de 62 anos de história  , nossa essência está enraizada na confiança, na excelência e na capacidade de transformar vidas por meio de soluções acessíveis, inteligentes e humanas.  Atualmente, protegemos  mais de 2 milhões de brasileiros  , atingindo a marca de 28 bilhões de capitais segurados  , e a confiança deles segue sendo nosso maior patrimônio.  O Programa de Formação de Especialistas em Seguro de Vida da Caburé  foi criado para dar oportunidade de formação a novos entrantes no mercado de seguros, para quem tem ambição de crescer financeira e profissionalmente, ingressando em  um dos setores de maior remuneração do mercado financeiro. O profissional atuará com prospecção ativa, reuniões com clientes, planejamento financeiro e gestão da própria carteira. Aqui você vai aprender a fazer vendas de forma consultiva na linha de frente do mercado financeiro, onde um talento comercial tem o ambiente ideal para crescer de forma meritocrática. About Us  Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.  Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.  As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.  Key Responsibilities:   Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.  Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.  Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.  Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;  Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral  Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels  Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures  Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements  Net-worth monitoring;  Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.  Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.  Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.  Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.  Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.    Requirements:   Legally resident in Brazil.  Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.  Demonstrated  independence from commercial functions  and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.   Strong knowledge of  Central Bank of Brazil  risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.   Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.  Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.  Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in  Portuguese and English  .   Must meet  fit and proper  standards with  no disqualifying factors  , including:   not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;  unblemished reputation;  knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;  technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.  not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

Sobre a Empresa O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos. Desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera. Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade. Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência. Sobre a Função Gerir, otimizar e monetizar o portfólio energético da Arauco Brasil, incluindo autoprodução e comercialização de excedentes no mercado livre e regulado, atuando na interface entre áreas industrial, financeira e jurídica, buscando maximizar resultados econômicos por meio da gestão eficiente de contratos, análise de mercado e conformidade regulatória. Responsabilidades Gerenciar o portfólio de energia da empresa, que inclui geração, consumo, contratos livres e regulados, de curto e longo prazo, convencionais e de autoprodução; Negociar junto a traders, comercializadoras e agentes do setor a compra e venda de energia; Monitorar e analisar o mercado de energia (Preços de curto e longo prazo, oferta e demanda, cenários hidrológicos); Desenvolver estratégias de comercialização do excedente energético e otimizar a alocação de energia entre consumo próprio e venda, visando maximização de receita e redução de custos; Acompanhar e garantir conformidade com regulamentações do setor elétrico; Realizar estudos de viabilidade econômica para novos projetos energéticos (biomassa, cogeração, etc.); Atuar na gestão de riscos (crédito, exposição ao mercado de curto prazo, variação de preços); Apoiar auditorias e reportes institucionais e de sustentabilidade; Se relacionar com as instituições do setor elétrico, incluindo ANEEL, ONS, CCEE, Distribuidoras e Transmissoras de Energia; Contribuir com o planejamento orçamentário e criticar os desvios, bem como elaborar reports para o nível executivo dos resultados da área de energia; Definir com a gestão, criar e acompanhar KPIs relacionados a energia, custos e receita de energia, realizando análises e auxiliando a gestão em decisões estratégicas; Desenvolver e automatizar processos de análise de indicadores através de ferramentas avançadas (BI, Excel, ERP); Propagar, cumprir e fazer cumprir a política de Meio Ambiente, qualidade, Segurança e Saúde Ocupacional, bem como, a política de ética e Compliance, por todos os colaboradores próprios e terceiros, assegurando o cumprimento da legislação e outros compromissos previstos, em todas as atividades produtos e serviços, incluindo os princípios e critérios das normas e ISOs. Local de atuação São Paulo/ SP Requisitos Graduação em Engenharia (Elétrica, Energia, Produção), Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Energia, Regulação do Setor Elétrico ou áreas afins Conhecimento em Integração Segurança Conhecimento em Ferramentas da qualidade Conhecimento em SAP, Power BI Vivência com autoprodução e/ou cogeração Experiência com comercialização de energia e gestão de contratos livres e regulados Conhecimento técnico em Regulação do setor elétrico brasileiro (ANEEL, CCEE, ONS). Proatividade, curiosidade e vontade de aprender. O QUE OFERECEMOS A VOCÊ? Junte-se a nós na BAT e faça parte de um ambiente que prospera no crescimento interno, onde a progressão de sua carreira não é apenas uma declaração – é uma realidade que estamos ansiosos para construir juntos. Aproveite essa oportunidade e seja dono do seu desenvolvimento; seu próximo capítulo começa aqui. Você terá acesso a plataformas de aprendizagem on-line e programas de desenvolvimento personalizados para aprimorar suas habilidades de liderança Priorizamos a melhoria contínua em um ambiente transformador, preparando-nos para mudanças constantes PORQUÊ JUNTAR-SE À BAT? Somos uma das poucas empresas nomeadas como Global Top Employer pelo Top Employers Institute - certificada em oferecer excelentes condições aos colaboradores. A colaboração, a inclusão e a parceria estão na base de tudo o que fazemos na BAT. Estamos ansiosos pra proporcionar que cada indivíduo prospere, independentemente do género, orientação sexual, estado civil, mudança de género, raça, religião ou crença, cor, nacionalidade, origem étnica ou nacional, deficiência, idade, competências, experiência, educação, contexto socioeconómico e profissional, estatuto de veterano, perspectivas e estilos de pensamento. Venha trazer a sua diferença e veja o que é possível para você na BAT. Saiba mais sobre a nossa cultura e a nossa premiada experiência para os funcionários. Se necessitar de quaisquer ajustes ou adaptações razoáveis para ajudar a ter o melhor desempenho possível durante o processo de recrutamento, encorajamos você a nos notificar. Estamos totalmente empenhados em apoiá-lo, tomando as medidas adequadas para que possa demonstrar todo o seu potencial.

vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Designer elétrico em arujá. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

A Roeslein Brasil abrange mais de 9.000 metros quadrados e é responsável pela fabricação de uma série de equipamentos especializados, incluindo transportadores, sistemas de biogás, skids de petróleo e gás e soluções industriais modulares. A equipe de São Paulo possui expertise profissional em uma ampla gama de serviços avançados de manufatura, incluindo corte a laser, prensagem, soldagem e sistemas de pintura eletrostática. Se você se identifica com o nosso ethos – ser sempre humilde, estar sempre disposto e feliz – confira a vaga disponível abaixo e venha fazer parte da nossa equipe! Atuação: 100% Presencial Região de Atuação: Arujá/SP Horário de Trabalho: Segunda à quinta-feira das 07h às 17h (com 1h para refeição) e sexta-feira das 07h às 16h (com 1h para refeição) Modelo de Trabalho: CLT RESUMO DA POSIÇÃO: Responsável pelo desenvolvimento de projetos elétricos e de automação industrial, incluindo painéis de controle, sistemas de instrumentação e infraestrutura elétrica. Atuará na elaboração da documentação técnica do projeto, desde as fases conceitual e básica até o detalhamento para fabricação e instalação, garantindo conformidade com normas técnicas, especificações de clientes e boas práticas da engenharia. O profissional também apoiará atividades de campo, integração com equipes de engenharia e suporte técnico durante fabricação, montagem e testes de painéis e equipamentos. DEVERES E RESPONSABILIDADES ESSENCIAIS: Desenvolver projetos elétricos de painéis de controle e sistemas de automação industrial, garantindo conformidade com requisitos técnicos e especificações do cliente. Elaborar e manter documentação técnica de engenharia, incluindo: Listas de I/O; Diagramas elétricos e diagramas de interligação; Listas de cabos; Listas de materiais (BOM); Arquiteturas de redes de automação; Especificações técnicas de painéis de controle e sistemas associados. Projetar e especificar componentes elétricos e de automação, incluindo circuitos de segurança, módulos de entrada e saída (I/O), redes industriais e sistemas de controle. Realizar Especificação da infraestrutura elétrica, incluindo eletrodutos, eletrocalhas, leitos de cabos, suportações e demais elementos de instalação. Assegurar que os projetos estejam em conformidade com normas técnicas aplicáveis, especificações contratuais e padrões internos de engenharia. Prestar suporte técnico às áreas de montagem, fabricação e comissionamento, esclarecendo dúvidas técnicas, revisando documentação e apoiando a correta implementação dos projetos. CONHECIMENTO / HABILIDADE / EDUCAÇÃO / EXPERIÊNCIA: Curso Técnico em Automação, Elétrica ou áreas correlatas. Desejável: 2 (dois) anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de projetos industriais nas áreas de automação e controle e vivência na elaboração e detalhamento de projetos elétricos e de automação, incluindo documentação técnica e suporte às etapas de fabricação e implementação. OUTROS ATRIBUTOS DESEJÁVEIS: Experiência na criação e desenvolvimento de layouts de painéis elétricos e de automação. Experiência com CLPs e inversores de frequência das plataformas Rockwell (Allen-Bradley) e/ou Siemens. Experiência com Auto CAD Electrical para desenvolvimento de diagramas e documentação técnica. Conhecimento em redes industriais, como Ether Net/IP, Profinet ou protocolos similares. BENEFÍCIOS Na Roeslein, investimos no sucesso e no bem-estar dos nossos colaboradores. Abaixo estão os benefícios oferecidos: Assistência médica (cobertura apartamento) e odontológica Seguro de Vida Vale refeição/alimentação (R$60,00 por dia útil) Incentivos para educação, com reembolsos para cursos de idiomas, cursos técnicos, graduações e especializações Incentivos para saúde física, com totalpass, reembolsos anuais de academia e reembolsos por corridas de ruas Programa de bônus Gratificação em viagens corporativas

Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. Core Responsibilities:   • Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.  • Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.  • Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.  • Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.  • System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including Hub Spot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.   Qualifications & Skills:   • Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market Saa S revenue engine.  • AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude Co Work, Code X) • Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI).  • Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.  • Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.  • Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2 B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Marketing ai agent builder em caraguatatuba. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Role Overview:   As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.   Core Responsibilities:   • Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.  • Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.  • Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.  • Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.  • System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including Hub Spot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.   Qualifications & Skills:   • Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market Saa S revenue engine.  • AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude Co Work, Code X) • Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI).  • Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.  • Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.  • Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2 B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

This role sits at the intersection of  Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI  , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle.  The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with  LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics  , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering “golden paths.”  Key Responsibilities    Champion an  AI-first engineering culture  through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity.   Define and measure impact using  DORA and SPACE metrics  , driving improvements across engineering workflows.   Build reusable patterns for:  AI-assisted code generation  Pull request automation  Test generation  Debugging workflows  Developer self-service enablement  Evaluate, prototype, and lead  POCs for AI tools  , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback.   Manage AI usage governance, including:  Token budgeting and cost controls  Usage monitoring and reporting  PII redaction guardrails  Audit logging and responsible AI practices  Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting  LLM pipelines  , APIs, and AI integrations.   Integrate AI tooling into  Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms  .   Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization.  Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.    Required Qualifications   8+ years of experience in  Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience  , or related engineering roles.   Strong hands-on experience with  LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling  in production or enterprise settings.   Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations.  Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing  AI/Saa S tools  , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management.   Practical daily usage of tools such as  Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT  , or similar.   Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities.  Strong AWS experience, ideally including:  Bedrock  API Gateway  Managed AI/Cloud Services  Experience with  Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines  (Git Lab preferred).   Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation.  Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.    Preferred / Nice to Have    Experience contributing to an  AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence  . vagas.title: Senior business analyst - supply chain
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Senior business analyst - supply chain em embu. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Who We Are  We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.  Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.  Who We Are Looking For   We are currently seeking a  Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain  , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).  This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.  If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.  Key Responsibilities   Business Requirements & Client Engagement   • Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.  • Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.  • Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.  • Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.  • Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.  Solution Design, Implementation & Testing   • Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).  • Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.  • Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.  • Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.  • Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.  • Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.  • Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.  • Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.  Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)  • Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.  • Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.  • Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.  Must Have   • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.  • Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).  • Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.  • Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).  • Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.  • Experience with project management and collaboration tools.  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.  • Availability to travel.  • Legally authorized to work in Brazil.  What We Offer   • Competitive salary and benefits package.  • Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.  • A collaborative and international work environment.  • Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.  Why Hoist?  If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.  Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Analista de pcp em são bernardo do campo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Sobre a empresa  Prazer, somos a FHOM Alimentos Saudáveis, uma empresa familiar, com 32 anos de mercado fabricando alimentos puros e saudáveis. Para quem ainda não sabe, o nome FHOM tem origem nas primeiras letras do nome do casal fundador e seus filhos.  Estamos presentes em todos os estados brasileiros, em mais de 5 mil pontos de venda, alcançando cada vez mais destaque nos segmentos de snacks saudáveis, orgânicos e FREE FROM.  Temos como base de trabalho 3 grandes frentes onde nos baseamos para todas as decisões, são elas:  QUALIDADE / PESSOAS / INOVAÇÃ O  Atualmente o parque industrial tem 8.500m2 e 70 colaboradores diretos e mais de 100 indiretos.  Os produtos da FHOM são reconhecidos pela alta qualidade e sabores deliciosos de seus produtos.  A FHOM prima por utilizar apenas ingredientes naturais e sem nenhum aditivo químico, comprados em sua maioria de pequenos produtores orgânicos e convencionais e tratados como se fossem da família.  Todo nosso processo é certificado por auditorias onde temos uma fabricação extremamente sofisticada porém, sem deixar de ser um produto artesanal.  Atualmente possuímos os selos SVB, Orgânico, e Kosher.  A linha Bem Orgânico é o braço orgânico da FHOM Alimentos, que desde 2013 produz e é pioneiro na fabricação de batatas chips orgânicas do Brasil.  Acreditamos e trabalhamos para que todos os envolvidos, desde o produtor rural até o consumidor final dos nossos produtos, estejam felizes e satisfeitos.  Assim, teremos certeza de que realizamos nossa tarefa da melhor maneira possível e que ela valeu a pena.  Responsabilidades Planejar, programar e controlar a produção, garantindo o atendimento da demanda com eficiência  Elaborar e acompanhar o forecast de produção junto ao comercialo (PMP) Gerenciar níveis de estoque de matérias-primas e produtos acabados  Analisar capacidade produtiva e propor melhorias de fluxo  Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (OTIF, giro de estoque, lead time, etc.) Atuar em conjunto com compras, logística e produção para alinhamento de demandas  Identificar gargalos e propor soluções para otimização de processos   Requisitos Formação em Engenharia de Produção, Administração, Logística ou áreas correlatas  Experiência sólida em PCP, preferencialmente na indústria de alimentos ou bens de consumo  Conhecimento no sistemas ERP TOTVS Protheus  Excel avançado (desejável conhecimento em Power BI ou ferramentas analíticas) Experiência com controle de estoque e planejamento de demanda  Perfil analítico, organizado e com boa capacidade de comunicação   ⭐ Diferenciais Experiência no segmento de alimentos saudáveis ou perecíveis  Vivência em ambientes com alta variabilidade de demanda   Nível da vaga  Pleno ou Sênior (de acordo com experiência e senioridade do candidato) Benefícios (Preencher conforme política da empresa) Vale alimentação/refeição  Vale transporte  Convênio Farmácia  PLR  (Outros benefícios)  Por que trabalhar com a gente? Aqui você fará parte de uma empresa em crescimento, com propósito claro de promover saúde através da alimentação, em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo.

vagas.title: Commercial lead — brazil
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Commercial lead — brazil em santa catarina. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Regrow  Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.  About the Role   As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.  You will work closely with our Head of Lat Am, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.  This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.  What You’ll Do   Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.  Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.  Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.  Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.  Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.  Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.  Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.  Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.    What You’ll Bring   Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2 B environments.  Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.  Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.  Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.  Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or Saa S platforms.  Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.  Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.  Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.  Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.  Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.  Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.    Nice to Have   Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.  Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.  Working knowledge of Spanish.    Why Regrow   Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.  High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.  A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.  Competitive compensation and benefits.      Acerca de Regrow   Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.  Sobre el Rol   Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.  Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de Lat Am, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.  Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.  Qué Harás   Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.  Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.  Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.  Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.  Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.  Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.  Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.  Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.    Qué Aportarás   Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2 B complejos.  Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.  Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.  Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.  Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas Saa S.  Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.  Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.  Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.  Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.  Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.  Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.    Deseable   Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.  Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.  Conocimiento funcional del español.    Por Qué Regrow   Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala.  Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.  Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica.  Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

vagas.title: Commercial lead — brazil
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Commercial lead — brazil em agudos. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Regrow  Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.  About the Role   As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.  You will work closely with our Head of Lat Am, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.  This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.  What You’ll Do   Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.  Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.  Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.  Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.  Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.  Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.  Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.  Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.    What You’ll Bring   Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2 B environments.  Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.  Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.  Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.  Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or Saa S platforms.  Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.  Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.  Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.  Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.  Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.  Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.    Nice to Have   Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.  Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.  Working knowledge of Spanish.    Why Regrow   Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.  High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.  A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.  Competitive compensation and benefits.      Acerca de Regrow   Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.  Sobre el Rol   Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.  Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de Lat Am, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.  Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.  Qué Harás   Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.  Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.  Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.  Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.  Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.  Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.  Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.  Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.    Qué Aportarás   Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2 B complejos.  Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.  Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.  Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.  Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas Saa S.  Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.  Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.  Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.  Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.  Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.  Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.    Deseable   Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.  Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.  Conocimiento funcional del español.    Por Qué Regrow   Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala.  Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.  Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica.  Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

vagas.title: Senior business analyst - supply chain
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior business analyst - supply chain em criciúma. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Who We Are  We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.  Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.  Who We Are Looking For   We are currently seeking a  Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain  , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).  This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.  If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.  Key Responsibilities   Business Requirements & Client Engagement   • Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.  • Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.  • Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.  • Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.  • Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.  Solution Design, Implementation & Testing   • Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).  • Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.  • Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.  • Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.  • Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.  • Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.  • Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.  • Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.  Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)  • Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.  • Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.  • Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.  Must Have   • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.  • Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).  • Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.  • Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).  • Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.  • Experience with project management and collaboration tools.  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.  • Availability to travel.  • Legally authorized to work in Brazil.  What We Offer   • Competitive salary and benefits package.  • Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.  • A collaborative and international work environment.  • Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.  Why Hoist?  If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.  Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

vagas.title: Senior business analyst - supply chain
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Senior business analyst - supply chain em esteio. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Who We Are  We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.  Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.  Who We Are Looking For   We are currently seeking a  Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain  , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).  This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.  If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.  Key Responsibilities   Business Requirements & Client Engagement   • Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.  • Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.  • Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.  • Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.  • Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.  Solution Design, Implementation & Testing   • Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).  • Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.  • Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.  • Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.  • Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.  • Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.  • Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.  • Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.  Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)  • Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.  • Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.  • Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.  Must Have   • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.  • Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).  • Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.  • Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).  • Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.  • Experience with project management and collaboration tools.  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.  • Availability to travel.  • Legally authorized to work in Brazil.  What We Offer   • Competitive salary and benefits package.  • Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.  • A collaborative and international work environment.  • Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.  Why Hoist?  If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.  Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

vagas.title: Commercial lead — brazil
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Commercial lead — brazil em jaraguá do sul. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Regrow  Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.  About the Role   As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.  You will work closely with our Head of Lat Am, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.  This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.  What You’ll Do   Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.  Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.  Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.  Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.  Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.  Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.  Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.  Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.    What You’ll Bring   Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2 B environments.  Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.  Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.  Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.  Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or Saa S platforms.  Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.  Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.  Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.  Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.  Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.  Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.    Nice to Have   Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.  Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.  Working knowledge of Spanish.    Why Regrow   Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.  High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.  A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.  Competitive compensation and benefits.      Acerca de Regrow   Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas. Atribuições:   Interface Técnica com Clientes: Atuar como ponto focal em reuniões com os times de TI dos clientes (operadoras de saúde) para alinhar requisitos de integração, layouts de dados e especificações de API;  Gestão e Organização Técnica: Traduzir requisitos de negócio em tarefas técnicas claras, quebrando demandas complexas em entregáveis menores para orientar o trabalho dos desenvolvedores Juniors e Plenos;  Arquitetura e Design: Projetar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alta performance utilizando Node.js (Nest JS/Next.js);  Sustentação e Confiabilidade: Atuar na manutenção dos sistemas em produção, identificando, diagnosticando e corrigindo bugs e falhas (em sistemas, fontes de dados e APIs) de forma ágil para garantir a continuidade dos serviços;  Mentoria e Qualidade: Realizar Code Reviews rigorosos e disseminar boas práticas (Clean Code, SOLID), elevando a barra técnica da equipe;  Padronização e Performance: Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e identificar gargalos de performance em cenários de alto volume de dados. Role Overview:   As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.   Core Responsibilities:   • Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.  • Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.  • Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.  • Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.  • System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including Hub Spot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.   Qualifications & Skills:   • Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market Saa S revenue engine.  • AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude Co Work, Code X) • Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI).  • Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.  • Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.  • Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2 B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

Build reusable patterns for:  AI-assisted code generation  Pull request automation  Test generation  Debugging workflows  Developer self-service enablement  Evaluate, prototype, and lead  POCs for AI tools  , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback.   Manage AI usage governance, including:  Token budgeting and cost controls  Usage monitoring and reporting  PII redaction guardrails  Audit logging and responsible AI practices  Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting  LLM pipelines  , APIs, and AI integrations.   Integrate AI tooling into  Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms  .   Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization.  Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.    Required Qualifications   8+ years of experience in  Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience  , or related engineering roles.   Strong hands-on experience with  LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling  in production or enterprise settings.   Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations.  Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing  AI/Saa S tools  , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management.   Practical daily usage of tools such as  Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT  , or similar.   Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities.  Strong AWS experience, ideally including:  Bedrock  API Gateway  Managed AI/Cloud Services  Experience with  Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines  (Git Lab preferred).   Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation.  Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.    Preferred / Nice to Have    Experience contributing to an  AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence  .   Hands-on experience with:  LLM Agents  RAG pipelines  Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index  Exposure to  AI Fin Ops  , usage reporting, and cost attribution models.   Knowledge of  AI governance and security  , including:   OWASP Top 10 for LLMs  Prompt injection risks  Model supply chain security  Responsible AI controls  Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

Sobre a empresaPrazer, somos a FHOM Alimentos Saudáveis, uma empresa familiar, com 32 anos de mercado fabricando alimentos puros e saudáveis. Para quem ainda não sabe, o nome FHOM tem origem nas primeiras letras do nome do casal fundador e seus filhos. Estamos presentes em todos os estados brasileiros, em mais de 5 mil pontos de venda, alcançando cada vez mais destaque nos segmentos de snacks saudáveis, orgânicos e FREE FROM. Temos como base de trabalho 3 grandes frentes onde nos baseamos para todas as decisões, são elas: QUALIDADE / PESSOAS / INOVAÇÃO Atualmente o parque industrial tem 8.500m2 e 70 colaboradores diretos e mais de 100 indiretos. Os produtos da FHOM são reconhecidos pela alta qualidade e sabores deliciosos de seus produtos. A FHOM prima por utilizar apenas ingredientes naturais e sem nenhum aditivo químico, comprados em sua maioria de pequenos produtores orgânicos e convencionais e tratados como se fossem da família. Todo nosso processo é certificado por auditorias onde temos uma fabricação extremamente sofisticada porém, sem deixar de ser um produto artesanal. Atualmente possuímos os selos SVB, Orgânico, e Kosher. A linha Bem Orgânico é o braço orgânico da FHOM Alimentos, que desde 2013 produz e é pioneiro na fabricação de batatas chips orgânicas do Brasil. Acreditamos e trabalhamos para que todos os envolvidos, desde o produtor rural até o consumidor final dos nossos produtos, estejam felizes e satisfeitos. Assim, teremos certeza de que realizamos nossa tarefa da melhor maneira possível e que ela valeu a pena. ResponsabilidadesPlanejar, programar e controlar a produção, garantindo o atendimento da demanda com eficiência Elaborar e acompanhar o forecast de produção junto ao comercialo (PMP) Gerenciar níveis de estoque de matérias-primas e produtos acabados Analisar capacidade produtiva e propor melhorias de fluxo Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (OTIF, giro de estoque, lead time, etc.) Atuar em conjunto com compras, logística e produção para alinhamento de demandas Identificar gargalos e propor soluções para otimização de processos  RequisitosFormação em Engenharia de Produção, Administração, Logística ou áreas correlatas Experiência sólida em PCP, preferencialmente na indústria de alimentos ou bens de consumo Conhecimento no sistemas ERP TOTVS Protheus Excel avançado (desejável conhecimento em Power BI ou ferramentas analíticas) Experiência com controle de estoque e planejamento de demanda Perfil analítico, organizado e com boa capacidade de comunicação  DiferenciaisExperiência no segmento de alimentos saudáveis ou perecíveis Vivência em ambientes com alta variabilidade de demanda  Nível da vagaPleno ou Sênior (de acordo com experiência e senioridade do candidato) Benefícios(Preencher conforme política da empresa) Vale alimentação/refeição Vale transporte Convênio Farmácia PLR (Outros benefícios)  Por que trabalhar com a gente?Aqui você fará parte de uma empresa em crescimento, com propósito claro de promover saúde através da alimentação, em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo.
