Nufarm. Evolving Ag. Nufarm is a global crop protection and seed technologies company that helps farmers and businesses meet the global challenges of food, feed, fibre and fuel production. Whether it's commercialising the world's first plant-based omega-3, launching precision agricultural solutions, unlocking biomass oils for more sustainable fuels and fast-moving consumer goods, launching innovative new crop protection solutions or delivering the crop and seed solutions farmers depend on every day, Nufarm is evolving with agriculture to drive value for customers. Your Future, Fuelled by Innovation The Global Compliance Lead, Bioenergy Assurance is responsible for the effective execution of Nufarm's global Assurance Program and related compliance systems. The role leads global certification and audit direction, works closely with regional teams to achieve and maintain 100% certification readiness and compliance, and broadens program oversight beyond certification to include legal, environmental, social, traceability, and internal policy requirements. This position also oversees internal assessment of centrally managed global processes - including GHG tool governance, methodology determination, risk management, and related controls - to identify gaps, drive corrective actions, and strengthen end-to-end assurance performance across the business. How You'll Help Us Grow Lead global certification and audit direction across the Assurance Program, including coordination with certification bodies, auditors, and regional teams. Monitor and collaborate with relevant global certification schemes to maintain Nufarm's leadership and competitive position. Own interpretation and implementation guidance for certification requirements, standards, procedures, and related external scheme updates. Drive certification readiness and performance across regions to achieve and maintain 100% certification compliance. Oversee certification program deployment and implementation for new countries, processors, value chain partners, and applicable carbon-credit or market requirements. Support and provide oversight across the internal audit program(s) for regional assurance activities, ensuring audits are completed well, correctly, and comprehensively. This role is not responsible for regional program implementation. Conduct internal assessment or audit of centrally managed global processes owned by the global team, potentially including GHG tool modelling and development, methodology determination, documentation controls, and risk management processes. Identify control gaps, process weaknesses, and compliance risks across legal, environmental, social, and internal requirements. Verify that centrally managed processes are documented, version-controlled, implemented consistently, and supported by appropriate evidence. Facilitate or oversee risk identification, risk assessment, risk management, and risk monitoring activities required under the Assurance Program and associated standards. Contribute to updates to global certification documentation, audit tools, SOPs, work instructions, and related compliance materials. Partner with program management, data/IT, and regional teams to strengthen systems, reporting, and process design for ongoing program improvement. Review regional audit outputs, supporting evidence, and corrective action plans; escalate and ensure closure of significant non-compliances as appropriate. Monitor regional execution of land use verification, traceability, mass balance, UDB-related direction, training, and documentation expectations. Assess regional capability and provide coaching, training, and tools to improve audit quality and consistency. Build trusted working relationships across regions and functions to align expectations, remove barriers, and reinforce accountability. Provide leadership, mentoring, and development for any direct reports and strong matrix leadership for regional assurance personnel. Support training, communication, and change management efforts related to certification, compliance, and assurance.  If you want to be a part of a thriving, supportive environment and are inspired by the prospect of being a part of something bigger, we'd love to hear from you. Nufarm is proud to be recognised as an endorsed top 10 employer of choice for all women by WORK180. A note to recruitment agencies - we have this role covered. There is no need to get in touch, we do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Operations director em mogi mirim. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Kinetic Homes - Operations Director  Introduction:   Kinetic Homes is a homebuilder based in Jacksonville FL focused on expanding homeownership by constructing high quality, affordable homes in vibrant neighborhoods. The business was founded by Erik Nordahl and has built & sold over 100 homes over the past 3 years.  This role will be an early hire in a rapidly growing organization. The individual for this role will report directly to the founder, Erik Nordahl. Mentorship and professional development are critical to Erik, and he will seek to assist his colleagues in their professional development and share the learnings he has accumulated throughout his career. This individual will have opportunity to eventually manage a team of individual contributors in the future.  Compensation:   $40,000-90,000 USD per year.    Duties & Responsibilities:   Permitting  Ensure all necessary permits are obtained for new construction projects.  Complete and submit permit applications for new construction.  Assist with septic permits and HOA applications.  Address permit application rejections in a timely manner.  Facilitate communication between surveyors, architects, engineers, etc. via email and phone.  Regularly call and email vendors and city officials to ensure timely deliverables.  Maintain database to ensure files are updated with all necessary documentation.  Maintain a knowledge of and be prepared to answer questions about the status of permits for all new construction.    Development Support  Prepare permit packages to be sent to our field development team.  File required documentation through online portals to be recorded with the appropriate county.    Procurement  Regularly solicit updated pricing among vendors to ensure we are obtaining competitive pricing.  Request purchase orders for active jobs that are under construction.  Check invoices from vendors to ensure that invoiced amounts match master pricing agreements.    Transaction Support  Prepare drafts of Purchase & Sale contracts.  Assist team in due diligence process coordination for all transactions.  Maintain closing calendars for transactions to ensure team is aware of key deadlines and terms.    Qualifications:   University degree. Four or more years of successful experience in a professional work environment  Strong skills in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and Adobe PDF.  Interest and use of latest AI technology products is key. Interest and curiosity in how to streamline operations through AI and technology is viewed positively.  Possess strong verbal and written English skills.  Must be highly organized and attentive to detail.  Willing to work in high-pressure environment.  Willing to be responsive and communicative.  Availability is key. Candidate must be willing to respond to time-sensitive requests outside of normal working hours. Normal working hours are 9 AM to 5 PM EST.  The team member may occasionally be asked to work weekends, but that is abnormal.  Good attitude necessary.

Estamos buscando entusiastas do esporte que residam perto dos estados abaixo para se juntarem à nossa equipe como coletores de dados para eventos de futebol. Qualificações e Requisitos: Conhecimento básico de inglês Possuir um dispositivo Android/i Phone Concluir um treinamento online para aprender a trabalhar com o aplicativo móvel Não é necessário ter formação em jornalismo Local de trabalho: Estádios de futebol e outros locais esportivos Oferecemos: Trabalho perfeito para estudantes ou para complementar a renda Treinamento completo e gratuito 62 euros (aproximadamente 405 reais) por partida coberta, além de reembolso de despesas de viagem e ingressos Estados onde precisamos urgentemente de pessoas para coleta de dados nos locais dos jogos: Alagoas Amazônia Espírito Santo Goiás Maranhão Mato Grosso/Mato Grosso do Sul Pará Paraíba Piauí Rondônia Roraima Aproveite a oportunidade para se juntar à nossa equipe e candidate-se agora!

vagas.title: Gtm builder
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Gtm builder em santa cruz do sul. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

GTM builder  You are an AI-native builder. You don’t just use AI tools; you build agents, copilots, and autonomous systems. You understand how modern LLMs actually work: tool use, reasoning loops, structured outputs, retrieval, memory, and orchestration. You are comfortable vibe-coding, shipping fast, and learning new AI tooling weekly. You’ve built side projects, internal tools, or production systems using LLMs, agents, or automation frameworks. You think in systems, not scripts. You’ll be responsible for building A...  You know that the leverage of a single great AI builder today is 10–100x a traditional engineer. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.   You Will:   • Design and deploy autonomous AI agents that can research, reason, and execute real business workflows  • Build agentic systems using modern LLM capabilities including tool use, function calling, structured outputs, and multi-step reasoning  • Create internal AI copilots used daily by marketing, sales and operations  • Implement retrieval systems (RAG) using embeddings and vector databases to give agents context and memory  • Build AI workflows that can enrich accounts, qualify leads, generate insights, and automate execution  • Integrate AI agents deeply into our stack: Hub Spot, internal databases, enrichment platforms, and product systems  • Automate workflows that previously required human operational effort  • Build scraping, parsing, and AI extraction systems to convert unstructured web data into structured intelligence  • Rapidly prototype, test, and deploy new AI capabilities as new models and tools become available  • Continuously improve agents to make them faster, smarter, cheaper, and more reliable  • Build reusable internal frameworks, tools, and agent architectures  • Own systems end-to-end — from idea to production   You Have:   • Strong software engineering ability and the ability to ship working systems quickly  • Hands-on experience building with modern LLMs and AI tools (Open AI, Anthropic, open models, or similar) • Experience building AI agents, copilots, or automated workflows  • Strong prompt engineering skills and understanding of structured prompting and reliability  • Experience integrating APIs, webhooks, and external systems  • Ability to work with structured and unstructured data  • Experience with automation tools like N8 N, Make, Zapier, or similar  • Comfort working with web scraping, enrichment systems, and data pipelines  • Strong builder mindset — you learn fast, experiment fast, and ship fast  • High agency — you figure things out without needing step-by-step instructions  • Curiosity and obsession with new AI capabilities  • Bonus: Experience with vector databases, embeddings, or retrieval systems  • Bonus: Experience building multi-step agent workflows  • Bonus: You actively build AI projects outside of work  • Bonus: You use AI coding tools as part of your daily workflow

vagas.description:

Job Title: Platform Engineer / Dev Ops Engineer Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration:12+ months with extensions Work Schedule:8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: EST Location:100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)Overview We're hiring a hands-on Platform / Dev Ops Engineerto join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a"boots-on-the-ground" execution role—not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables100–150 engineersto ship code efficiently and reliably. You'll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role inday-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement. What You'll Do Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup) Manage Kubernetes environments: deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting Support and enhance CI/CD pipelines(Git Lab CI preferred; Jenkins/Git Hub Actions acceptable) Maintain and improveself-service workflows, templates, and developer "golden paths" Work with observability tools (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Open Telemetry) to monitor systems and improve signal quality Assist withservice instrumentationacross logging, metrics, and tracing Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs Participate inon-call rotationand support incident response Optimize infrastructure forcost, performance, and reliability Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)Must-Have Requirements 6+ yearsin Platform Engineering / Dev Ops / SRE / Infrastructure roles Strong AWS experience(IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, Cloud Watch, etc.) Deep Kubernetes expertise: Operating and maintaining clusters Experience building Kubernetes environments Hands-on Terraform (Infrastructure as Code) Python scripting (mandatory)for automation and tooling Experience owning and maintaining CI/CD pipelines Strong Linux fundamentals Solid understanding ofobservability concepts(metrics, logs, tracing)Preferred Qualifications Experience with Git Lab CI Exposure to Open Telemetry API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java) Experience supportinglarge engineering teams (100+ developers) Familiarity withsecurity in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS) Background inmid-size, modern engineering organizations What We're NOT Looking For No Kubernetes experience Bash-only engineers (no Python) Pure consulting/advisory profiles Pure security-focused candidates Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ML/Data Science profiles Team Structure 1 Principal Engineer 1 Senior Engineer 1 Engineer (India) You = 4th key team member

vagas.title: Senior data engineer
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Senior data engineer em marília. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Who We Are:  We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.  The 3 G’s of RE:   “Get Shit Done.” “Get Over Shit.” “Give a Shit.” What You’ll Do:   Design and build Spark data ETL pipelines on AWS data platform.  Collaborate with cross functional teams such as data scientists, fraud, marketing and other business stakeholders to understand their data needs and deliver reliable solutions.  Optimize data infrastructure - Design and maintain robust data infrastructure by using modern data platform architecture.  Ensure data quality and reliability.  Innovate and follow best practices.  Ensure operational excellence of the data platform, including monitoring, incident response, performance optimization, and continuous improvement. vagas.title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Senior backend engineer (golang) em biguaçu. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

Mantemos o foco na qualidade, na eficiência operacional e na excelência no atendimento ao cliente.Acreditamos que resultados sustentáveis nascem da autorresponsabilidade e da dedicação ao essencial. Nossa cultura, pautada na autonomia, colaboração, organização e praticidade, está refletida nos seguintes princípios:Essencialismo: Priorizamos o que gera valor. Evitamos excesso de processos e mantemos ambientes físicos e digitais organizados e funcionais.Responsabilidade individual: Esperamos que cada colaborador assuma o protagonismo da própria evolução, com consciência e compromisso.Capricho e qualidade: A atenção aos detalhes é fundamental para nosso padrão de excelência. Prezamos entregas bem executadas, com precisão e zelo.Melhoria contínua: Incentivamos a busca ativa por conhecimento. Entendemos que aprender e aprimorar são necessidades constantes.Mentalidade orientada à solução: Além de identificar problemas e desafios, nossos profissionais buscam soluções viáveis, traduzindo ideias em planos de ação.SOBRE A VAGACargo:Assistente de LogísticaLocal:Sede operacional – São Marcos, Joinville/SCTipo de contratação:CLT (presencial)Remuneração:R$ 2.500,00Carga horária:Segunda a Sexta, das 08h às 17h, com 1h de intervaloBonificação trimestral por desempenho:R$ 750,00Bonificação anual por meta da empresa batida:14º SalárioBenefícios:PDI (Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual)Vale-refeição (VR): 400,00 mensalVale-transporte (VT)ATRIBUIÇÕESO profissional atuará nas operações diárias da empresa, sendo responsável pelo controle de estoque, processamento de pedidos e organização logística, garantindo um fluxo ágil, o cumprimento dos prazos e a eficiência operacional. Suas responsabilidades incluem:Faturamento de pedidos;P&P (Picking and Packing);Coleta e confirmação de recebimento;Baixa de pedidos em Marketplaces;Controle e organização de estoque diário;Contagem e controle de inventário semanalProtocolo de segurança, abertura e fechamento da sedeEnviar e gerir estoque enviado a terceiros com finalidade de conserto.Controle e organização de suprimentos (insumos, embalagens etc) e ativos;Destinação final de devoluções;Recebimento, conferência e alocação de importações;Agendamento de coleta no porto;Emissão de nota fiscal (transferência com ou sem quebra da cadeia do IPI, com ou sem ICMS; reclassificação de mercadorias (formação ou desagregação de kits);Abastecimento de Estoque Fulfillment;Preparar e organizar envios de mercadorias a centros de distribuição de parceiros, garantindo a conformidade dos processos;Realizar cotações para compras eventuais de estoque nacional, ativo imobilizado, serviços gerais e outras demandas operacionais;Manter atualizada a lista de fornecedores de itens de uso e consumo;Descrever e atualizar processos relacionados à função.REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÃOCompetências obrigatórias:- Ensino Médio completo.- Pacote Office básico.Competências desejadas:- Experiência prévia com operações de e-commerce, almoxarifado e estoque;- Excel intermediário/avançado;- Experiência prévia em compras.- Experiência prévia em compras;- Conhecimento em sistemas e automações.EXPECTATIVASO que buscamos:Organização e atenção aos detalhes: capacidade de manter o ambiente organizado, conferir mercadorias e evitar erros no despacho de pedidos;Disposição e proatividade: facilidade para carregar caixas, preparar pacotes e movimentar mercadorias;Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe e resolver demandas com autonomia.O que oferecemos:Treinamento técnico e desenvolvimento pessoal;Direcionamento estratégico;Objetividade na cobrança e feedback;Liberdade com responsabilidade;Sinceridade e transparência.ETAPAS DO PROCESSO SELETIVOTriagem de currículos– Análise de perfil profissional.Contato inicial– Esclarecimento de informações e alinhamento de expectativas.Teste avaliativo– Enviado por e-mail aos candidatos selecionados.Entrevista– Avaliação do RH e gestor da área.Feedback e contratação– Formalização da contratação.Nossa equipe te espera!

Descrição do CargoExperiência no setor de saúde é desejável, com bom entendimento de sistemas de saúde, operações clínicas, etc.Mínimo de 8 a 10 anos de forte experiência trabalhando com Oracle Cloud Financials – módulos GL, FAH, EDMCS e AR.Experiência em projetos de suporte e melhorias (enhancements).Experiência em desenho e implementação de soluções de sistemas para processos financeiros principais, especialmente nas áreas deRecords to Report (R2 R)eOrder to Cash (O2 C).Capacidade de liderar de forma independente o desenho e a transformação da estrutura empresarial, como mapeamento de COA (plano de contas), razão (ledger) e estrutura de unidades de negócio (BU) para empresas complexas.Experiência no desenho de soluções para contabilidade regulatória, como FERC.Forte habilidade na criação de modelos complexos de alocação para CAPEX, Receita e OPEX.Forte experiência na configuração do Oracle Cloud GL e Accounting Hub para mapeamento de plano de contas (COA), incluindo o desenho de interfaces complexas com sistemas externos.Experiência na criação de relatórios complexos utilizando Smart View, FRS, BI Publisher e OTBI.Forte conhecimento de ferramentas de integração como FBDI, Webservices e familiaridade com OIC, incluindo componentes Oracle Paa S.Experiência na criação de documentos de design funcional para objetos RICE e na coordenação com equipes técnicas e funcionais durante design, desenvolvimento, testes e implantação.Responsável por gerenciar o desenho e a entrega ponta a ponta de objetos RICE de alto volume (Interfaces, Conversões, Extensões e Relatórios).O profissional deve ter fortes habilidades de comunicação para interagir com diversos stakeholders e experiência em todas as fases do projeto: planejamento, levantamento de requisitos, análise de gaps, design, configuração, testes e treinamento, implantação e suporte.
